ModMetaData.name: RimMT
ModMetaData.author: Allen / Rimworld-Project
ModMetaData.description: RimMT V0.4.3.2 Playtest fixes a worker path result copy bug that caused NodeCount and PathHash to be lost after A* reconstruction. It replaces geometry-only validation with multi-axis path parity telemetry: found-state parity, worker legality, endpoint correctness, snapshot-relative path cost delta, node-count delta and geometry divergence. AdaptiveTPS TickManagerUpdate transpiler coexistence remains explicitly supported. Worker paths remain shadow-only and vanilla PawnPath remains authoritative.
